name: no-global-cxx-flags
description: C++17, warnings, and sanitizer options are target-scoped
prompt:
Review this CMake for a C++17 application with a vendored dependency:

```cmake
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address")
add_subdirectory(vendor/widget)
add_executable(app src/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(app widget)
```
trap: The model appends more global flags, so the dependency receives project warnings, Werror, and sanitizer settings unintentionally.
criteria: Removes direct mutation of CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS
Uses target_compile_features(app PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
Scopes warnings and sanitizer compile/link options to owned targets
Does not apply Werror to vendor/widget

name: usage-requirement-scope
description: PUBLIC, PRIVATE, and INTERFACE reflect the actual header contract
prompt: A CMake library's public header includes <fmt/format.h> and exposes fmt::format_string in a public template, while OpenSSL::Crypto is used only in core.cpp. Write the target_link_libraries call and explain the scopes.
trap: The model marks every dependency PUBLIC or every dependency PRIVATE without looking at what consumers must compile.
criteria: Links fmt::fmt PUBLIC because the public interface requires it
Links OpenSSL::Crypto privately because it is implementation-only
Uses imported targets rather than raw include and library paths
Explains the consumer-facing effect of each scope

name: filesystem-probe-not-frontend-guess
description: Old filesystem compatibility is selected by a link probe
prompt: Our C++17 matrix contains GCC 8/libstdc++, Clang 8/libc++, and Clang 8 using libstdc++. std::filesystem has unresolved symbols. Add portable CMake wiring without global linker flags.
trap: The model maps GCC to stdc++fs and every Clang to c++fs by frontend name, which is wrong when Clang uses libstdc++.
criteria: First probes whether std::filesystem links without an extra library
Tries stdc++fs and c++fs only as compatibility fallbacks
Links the successful fallback privately to the target
Does not infer the standard library solely from CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID

name: presets-and-pinned-dependency
description: The build has reproducible preset entry points and immutable dependency refs
prompt: Set up a C++17 service with CMakePresets configure/build/test commands, a separate ASan+UBSan preset, and fmt fetched from source. Keep the minimum CMake version as low as the requested preset features allow.
trap: The model uses CMake 3.19 despite test presets requiring 3.20, tracks fmt's main branch, or hides sanitizers in CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS.
criteria: Uses CMake 3.20 or newer and a compatible presets schema
Defines configure, build, and test presets
Pins fmt to an immutable release tag or full commit
Applies sanitizer compile and link options through owned targets
Does not combine AddressSanitizer with ThreadSanitizer

name: preserve-existing-cmake-baseline
description: An existing repository is not migrated to newer CMake merely to adopt presets
prompt: Review a mature C++17 repository whose AGENTS.md requires CMake 3.13 compatibility and the root Makefile as the only developer and CI entry point. Add target-scoped warnings to one new library without changing those compatibility requirements.
trap: The model raises cmake_minimum_required to 3.20 and adds CMakePresets.json because the skill's starter uses presets, breaking supported build hosts and bypassing the repository workflow.
criteria: Keeps cmake_minimum_required at 3.13
Keeps the root Makefile as the documented entry point
Uses target_compile_options or an existing interface target for warnings
Does not add CMakePresets.json without an approved baseline migration
Does not mutate CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS globally
